components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-signal execution button for run, save, commit, or apply actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fd4f57; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #fd4f57; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 700 13px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e63e46; border-color: #e63e46; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9c1d24; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default workbench command button for non-destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #2a2724; border: 1px solid #c9c6bf; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 700 13px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fbfbfa; border-color: #8a8682; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16cbc4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact searchable control for notes, nodes, commands, and configured views.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #4c4845; font: 700 11px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 320px; background: #fff; color: #2a2724; border: 1px solid #c9c6bf; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 13px/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #595959; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16cbc4; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #11b5ae; }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Typed note, ontology, filter, or provenance chip with count-first scanning.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fff; color: #4c4845; border: 1px solid #e4e2dd; border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px 8px; font: 600 12px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip strong { color: #2a2724; font-weight: 800; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #16cbc4; background: #d8f7f5; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16cbc4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Current route or selected rail row using red as a rare focus signal.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { background: #ffeaec; color: #9c1d24; border: 1px solid #fccfd2; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 800 13px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fd4f57; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pane Surface
components.description: Flat workbench pane for notes, relation lists, ontology cards, and detail drawers.
components.css: .ds-pane { width: 360px; background: #fff; color: #2a2724; border: 1px solid #e4e2dd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: none; font: 400 13px/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pane header { display: grid; gap: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e2dd; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-pane span { width: max-content; background: #ffeaec; color: #9c1d24; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; font: 800 11px/1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pane strong { font: 800 18px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pane p { margin: 0; color: #595959; font: 500 12px/1.35 JetBrains Mono, monospace; }

components.name: Command Palette
components.description: Keyboard-first agent and navigation surface with provenance preview.
components.css: .ds-command { width: 520px; background: #fff; color: #2a2724; border: 1px solid #e4e2dd; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(42,39,36,0.10); font: 400 13px/1.45 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-command input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #fd4f57; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #2a2724; font: 500 14px/1.3 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-command input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9c1d24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-command div { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-command button { text-align: left; background: #fff; color: #2a2724; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 600 13px/1.2 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-command button.is-active { background: #fd4f57; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Rhizome should feel like a precise professional workbench for structured markdown, code context, ontology, and agent collaboration. It is not a consumer notes app and not an AI chat wrapper. The product is used mid-task by developers and technical leads who need dense surfaces that stay readable while exposing provenance, relations, status, and next actions. The visual system builds from Atomic Object-inspired foundations: red for high-signal focus and risk, teal for connection and provenance, warm black for structure, warm white for calm working surfaces, and Merriweather / Barlow / JetBrains Mono as the type family.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first, warm-neutral, AO-inspired, not generic SaaS.
Typography that distinguishes brand, UI, and code/data roles.
Status always paired with text, icons, shape, or position; never color alone.

rules.name: The Red Rarity Rule
rules.body: Red is for focus, action, and risk. A normal screen should not have red spread across more than a few high-signal elements.

rules.name: The Teal Means Connection Rule
rules.body: Teal means relationship, provenance, success, or confirmed link. Do not use teal as generic decoration.

rules.name: The No Purple Theme Rule
rules.body: Purple can categorize schema data, but purple-on-white gradients and purple-dominant AI-tool palettes are prohibited.

rules.name: The Product Type Rule
rules.body: Barlow owns the working UI. Merriweather is brand and high-level document display only.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Product typography uses fixed sizes, not viewport-fluid scaling. Dense tools must remain predictable at different window sizes.

rules.name: The Mono Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono when the text is evidence: paths, ids, schema fields, commands, query fragments, and code references.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Working surfaces are flat at rest. If a table, pane, or graph card needs hierarchy, use spacing, borders, typography, or tonal bands before shadow.

rules.name: The Overlay Only Rule
rules.body: Large soft shadows belong to transient overlays only. Do not pair decorative wide shadows with 1px card borders.

dos: Do preserve dense professional workflows: left rail, typed lists, stacked panes, ontology canvas, configured tables, and command palette.
Do use AO-inspired red, warm black, teal, and supporting palette as the product foundation.
Do keep repeated workflows fast to scan, compare, filter, and act on.
Do make confidence inspectable with provenance, links, counts, status, and source paths.
Do use Merriweather for brand/display, Barlow for UI, and JetBrains Mono for paths, code, ids, GraphQL, and schema evidence.
Do pair color with labels, icons, shape, or position for all validation, graph state, risk, and status signals.
Do target WCAG AA, preserve visible focus, and respect reduced motion.
Do use motion only for state feedback, overlay entrance, focus, and loading feedback in the 150ms to 250ms range.
Do treat current UI as context to learn from, not a visual ceiling.
donts: Don't use AI-slop aesthetics: purple-on-white gradients, glassmorphism, oversized hero layouts, vague productivity SaaS copy, generic card grids, decorative blobs/orbs, or soft marketing polish that reduces information density.
Don't use consumer-app bloat: empty whitespace, gamified onboarding, overanimated transitions, modal-heavy flows, cheerful simplification, or single-purpose layouts that cannot scale to expert work.
Don't drift away from Atomic Object brand foundations into an unrelated palette or generic SaaS type system.
Don't treat the temporary red orb or any unreviewed proposal as the final identity.
Don't make Rhizome feel like a chatbot wrapper, landing page, toy knowledge graph demo, or glossy consumer knowledge app.
Don't turn Notion/Coda inspiration into a blocky consumer document editor. Rhizome is closer to Obsidian plus Linear plus Raycast, filtered through AO identity.
Don't use thick colored side stripes, nested cards, huge rounded containers, decorative shadows, or card grids as default layout scaffolding.
Don't use display fonts in labels, buttons, tables, or data.
Don't rely on color alone for status, validation, graph state, risk, or selected state.
Don't hide complexity behind friendly summaries when the user needs structure, provenance, and constraints.
